QUOTE: NONE
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer never says that the buffer allocator needs MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY enabled. It only says the setter is compiled out when the compile-time macros are set, and that `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`. It also says "Define only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`" for the runtime route. It does not give the dependency of `MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C` on `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, or say that enabling the buffer allocator alone is not enough.
